Logo! Apne Parwardigar se daro ke qiyaamat ka zalzala bahut badi shai hai

Jis din tum dekhoge ke doodh pilaane waali auratein apne doodh peete bachchon se ghaafil ho jaayengi, aur haamila auratein apne haml ko gira dengi, aur log nashe ki haalat mein nazar aayenge haalaanke woh badmast nahin honge, balke Allah ka azaab hi bada sakht hoga
Aur logon mein kuch aise bhi hain jo baghair jaane boojhe Khuda ke baare mein jhagda karte hain aur har sarkash Shaitaan ka ittibaa' kar lete hain
Un ke baare mein yeh likh diya gaya hai ke jo Shaitaan ko apna dost banaaega Shaitaan use gumraah kar dega aur phir Jahannam ke azaab ki taraf rehnumaai kar dega

Aye logo! Agar tumhein dobaara uthaaye jaane mein shubha hai to yeh samajh lo ke hum ne hi tumhein pehle khaak se banaaya hai, phir nutfe se, phir jame hue khoon se, phir gosht ke lothde se jis mein se koi mukammal ho jaata hai aur koi naaqis hi reh jaata hai, taake hum tumhaare oopar apni qudrat ko waazeh kar dein. Hum jis cheez ko jab tak chaahte hain rahm mein rakhte hain, us ke baad tum ko bachcha bana kar baahar le aate hain, phir zinda rakhte hain taake jawaani ki umr tak pahunch jaao, aur phir tum mein se ba'z ko utha liya jaata hai aur ba'z ko past-tareen umr tak baaqi rakha jaata hai taake ilm ke baad phir kuch jaanne ke qaabil na reh jaaye. Aur tum zameen ko murda dekhte ho, phir jab hum paani barsa dete hain to woh lehlahaane lagti hai aur ubharne lagti hai aur har tarah ki khoobsoorat cheez ugaane lagti hai
Yeh is liye hai ke woh Allah Khuda-e-barhaq hai, aur wahi murdon ko zinda karta hai, aur wahi har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai
Aur qiyaamat yaqeenan aane waali hai, is mein kisi shak ki gunjaaish nahin hai, aur Allah qabron se murdon ko uthaane waala hai
Aur logon mein aise bhi hain jo ilm o hidaayat aur kitaab-e-muneer ke baghair bhi Khuda ke baare mein behas karte hain

Woh ghuroor se munh pheraaye hue hain taake doosre logon ko bhi raah-e-Khuda se gumraah kar sakein, to aise ashkhaas ke liye duniya mein ruswaai hai aur aakhirat mein hum inhein Jahannam ka maza chakhaayenge
Yeh us baat ki saza hai jo tum pehle kar chuke ho, aur Khuda apne bandon par hargiz zulm karne waala nahin hai

Aur logon mein kuch aise bhi hain jo Khuda ki ibaadat ek hi rukh par aur mashroot tareeqe se karte hain, ke agar un tak khair pahunch gaya to mutma'in ho jaate hain, aur agar koi museebat chhoo gayi to deen se palat jaate hain. Yeh duniya aur aakhirat dono mein khasaare mein hain, aur yahi khasaara khula hua khasaara hai
Yeh Allah ko chhod kar unhein pukaarte hain jo na inhein nuqsaan pahuncha sakte hain aur na faaida, aur yahi dar-asal bahut door tak phaili hui gumraahi hai
Yeh un ko pukaarte hain jin ka nuqsaan un ke faaide se zyaada qareeb-tar hai. Woh un ke badtareen sarparast aur badtareen saathi hain
Beshak Allah imaan waalon aur nek amal karne waalon ko un jannaton mein daakhil karega jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi, ke Allah jo chaahta hai anjaam deta hai

Jis shakhs ka khayaal yeh hai ke Allah duniya aur aakhirat mein us ki madad nahin karega use chaahiye ke ek rassi ke zariye aasmaan ki taraf badhe, aur phir us rassi ko kaat de, aur phir dekhe ke us ki tarkeeb us cheez ko door kar sakti hai ya nahin jis ke ghusse mein woh mubtala tha
Aur isi tarah hum ne is Quran ko waazeh nishaaniyon ki shakl mein naazil kiya hai, aur Allah jis ko chaahta hai hidaayat de deta hai

Beshak jo log imaan laaye aur jinhon ne Yahoodiyat ikhtiyaar ki ya sitaara-parast ho gaye ya Nasraani aur aatish-parast ho gaye ya mushrik ho gaye hain, Khuda qiyaamat ke din un sab ke darmiyaan yaqeeni faisla kar dega, ke Allah har shai ka nigraan aur gawaah hai

Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke zameen o aasmaan mein jis qadar bhi saahibaan-e-aql o sha'oor hain aur aaftaab o maahtaab aur sitaare, pahaad, darakht, chaupaaye aur insaanon ki ek kasrat sab hi Allah ke liye sajda-guzaar hain, aur un mein se bahut se aise bhi hain jin par azaab saabit ho chuka hai. Aur zaahir hai ke jise Khuda zaleel karna chaahe use koi izzat dene waala nahin hai, ke yaqeenan Allah jo chaahta hai woh kar sakta hai

Yeh momin o kaafir do baahami dushman hain jinhon ne Parwardigar ke baare mein aapas mein ikhtilaaf kiya hai. Phir jo log kaafir hain un ke waaste aag ke kapde qata' kiye jaayenge aur un ke saron par garma-garam paani undela jaaega
Jis se un ke pet ke andar jo kuch hai aur un ki jildein sab gal jaayengi
Aur un ke liye lohe ke gurz muhayya kiye gaye hain
Jab yeh Jahannam ki takleef se nikal bhaagna chaahenge to dobaara usi mein palta diye jaayenge ke abhi aur Jahannam ka maza chakho

Beshak Allah saahibaan-e-imaan aur nek amal karne waalon ko un jannaton mein daakhil karta hai jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hoti hain. Inhein un jannaton mein sone ke kangan aur moti pehnaaye jaayenge, aur un ka libaas us Jannat mein resham ka libaas hoga
Aur inhein paakeeza qaul ki taraf hidaayat di gayi hai, aur inhein Khuda-e-Hameed ke raaste ki taraf rehnumaai ki gayi hai

Beshak jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya aur logon ko Allah ke raaste aur Masjid-ul-Haraam se rokte hain jise hum ne tamaam insaanon ke liye baraabar se qaraar diya hai, chaahe woh maqaami hon ya baahar waale, aur jo bhi is masjid mein zulm ke saath ilhaad ka iraada karega hum use dardnaak azaab ka maza chakhaayenge

Aur us waqt ko yaad dilaayein jab hum ne Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ke liye Baitullah ki jagah muhayya ki ke khabardaar hamaare baare mein kisi tarah ka shirk na hone paaye, aur tum hamaare ghar ko tawaaf karne waalon, qiyaam karne waalon aur rukoo' o sujood karne waalon ke liye paak o paakeeza bana do
Aur logon ke darmiyaan Hajj ka e'laan kar do ke log tumhaari taraf paidal aur laaghar sawaariyon par door-daraaz ilaaqon se sawaar ho kar aayenge

Taake apne manaafe ka mushaahida karein, aur chand mu'ayyan dinon mein un chaupaayon par jo Khuda ne ba-taur-e-rizq ata kiye hain Khuda ka naam lein, aur phir tum us mein se khaao aur bhooke muhtaaj afraad ko khilaao
Phir logon ko chaahiye ke apne badan ki kasaafat ko door karein aur apni nazron ko poora karein aur us qadeem-tareen makaan ka tawaaf karein

Yeh ek hukm-e-Khuda hai, aur jo shakhs bhi Khuda ki mohtaram cheezon ki ta'zeem karega woh us ke haq mein pesh-e-Parwardigar behtari ka sabab hogi. Aur tumhaare liye tamaam jaanwar halaal kar diye gaye hain ilaawa un ke jin ke baare mein tum se bayaan kiya jaaega, lihaaza tum naapaak buton se parhez karte raho aur laghw aur muhmal baaton se ijtinaab karte raho

Allah ke liye mukhlis aur baatil se katra kar raho, aur kisi tarah ka shirk ikhtiyaar na karo, ke jo kisi ko us ka shareek banaata hai woh goya aasmaan se gir padta hai aur use parinda uchak leta hai ya hawa kisi door-daraaz jagah par le ja kar phenk deti hai
Yeh hamaara faisla hai, aur jo bhi Allah ki nishaaniyon ki ta'zeem karega yeh ta'zeem us ke dil ke taqwa ka nateeja hogi
Tumhaare liye in qurbaani ke jaanwaron mein ek muqarrara muddat tak faaide hi faaide hain, us ke baad un ki jagah Khaana-e-Ka'ba ke paas hai

Aur hum ne har qaum ke liye qurbaani ka tareeqa muqarrar kar diya hai taake jin jaanwaron ka rizq hum ne ata kiya hai un par naam-e-Khuda ka zikr karein. Phir tumhaara khuda sirf Khuda-e-Waahid hai, tum usi ke itaa'at-guzaar bano, aur hamaare gidgidaane waale bandon ko bashaarat de do

Jin ke saamne zikr-e-Khuda aata hai to un ke dil larz jaate hain, aur woh jo museebat par sabr karne waale aur namaaz qaaim karne waale hain, aur hum ne jo rizq diya hai us mein se hamaari raah mein kharch karne waale hain

Aur hum ne qurbaaniyon ke oont ko bhi apni nishaaniyon mein se qaraar diya hai, is mein tumhaare liye khair hai, lihaaza is par khade hone ki haalat hi mein naam-e-Khuda ka zikr karo, aur us ke baad jab us ke tamaam pehlu gir jaayein to us mein se khud bhi khaao aur qanaa'at karne waale aur maangne waale sab ghareebon ko khilaao. Ke hum ne inhein tumhaare liye musakhkhar kar diya hai taake tum shukr-guzaar bande ban jaao

Khuda tak na in jaanwaron ka gosht jaane waala hai aur na khoon, us ki baargaah mein sirf tumhaara taqwa jaata hai. Aur isi tarah hum ne in jaanwaron ko tumhaara taabe' bana diya hai ke Khuda ki di hui hidaayat par us ki kibriyaai ka e'laan karo, aur nek amal waalon ko bashaarat de do
Beshak Allah saahibaan-e-imaan ki taraf se difaa' karta hai, aur yaqeenan Allah khiyaanat karne waale kaafiron ko hargiz dost nahin rakhta hai
Jin logon se musalsal jang ki ja rahi hai inhein un ki mazloomiyat ki bina par jihaad ki ijaazat de di gayi hai, aur yaqeenan Allah un ki madad par qudrat rakhne waala hai

Yeh woh log hain jo apne gharon se bila kisi haq ke nikaal diye gaye hain, ilaawa is ke ke woh yeh kehte hain ke hamaara Parwardigar Allah hai. Aur agar Khuda ba'z logon ko ba'z ke zariye na rokta hota to tamaam girje aur Yahoodiyon ke ibaadat-khaane aur Majoosiyon ke ibaadat-khaane aur masjidein sab munhadim kar di jaatin, aur Allah apne madadgaaron ki yaqeenan madad karega, ke woh yaqeenan saahib-e-quwwat bhi hai aur saahib-e-izzat bhi hai

Yeh woh log hain jinhein hum ne zameen mein ikhtiyaar diya to unhon ne namaaz qaaim ki aur zakaat ada ki aur nekiyon ka hukm diya aur buraaiyon se roka, aur yeh tai hai ke jumla umoor ka anjaam Khuda ke ikhtiyaar mein hai
Aur Paighambar! Agar yeh log aap ko jhutlaate hain to un se pehle qaum-e-Nooh, qaum-e-Aad aur qaum-e-Samood ne yahi kaam kiya tha
Aur qaum-e-Ibraheem aur qaum-e-Loot ne bhi

Aur Ashaab-e-Madyan ne bhi, aur Moosa ko bhi jhutlaaya gaya hai, to hum ne kuffaar ko mohlat de di aur phir us ke baad inhein apni giraft mein le liya, to sab ne dekh liya ke hamaara azaab kaisa hota hai

Gharaz kitni hi bastiyaan hain jinhein hum ne tabaah o barbaad kar diya ke woh zaalim thin, to ab woh apni chhaton ke bal ulti padi hain, aur un ke kuwein mu'attal pade hain, aur un ke mazboot mahal bhi mismaar ho gaye hain

Kya un logon ne zameen mein sair nahin ki hai ke un ke paas aise dil hote jo samajh sakte aur aise kaan hote jo sun sakte? Is liye ke dar-haqeeqat aankhein andhi nahin hoti hain, balke woh dil andhe hote hain jo seenon ke andar paaye jaate hain

Paighambar! Yeh log aap se azaab mein ujlat ka taqaaza kar rahe hain, haalaanke Khuda apne waade ke khilaaf hargiz nahin kar sakta hai, aur aap ke Parwardigar ke nazdeek ek din bhi un ke shumaar ke hazaar saal ke baraabar hota hai
Aur kitni hi bastiyaan thin jinhein hum ne mohlat di haalaanke woh zaalim thin, phir hum ne inhein apni giraft mein le liya, aur bil-aakhir sab ki baazgasht hamaari hi taraf hai
Aap keh dijiye ke insaano! Main tumhaare liye sirf waazeh taur par daraane waala hoon
Phir jo log imaan le aaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye hain un ke liye maghfirat aur behtareen rizq hai
Aur jin logon ne hamaari nishaaniyon ke baare mein koshish ki ke hum ko aajiz kar dein woh sab ke sab Jahannam mein jaane waale hain

Aur hum ne aap se pehle koi aisa rasool ya nabi nahin bheja hai ke jab bhi us ne koi nek aarzoo ki to Shaitaan ne us ki aarzoo ki raah mein rukaawat daal di, to phir Khuda ne Shaitaan ki daali hui rukaawat ko mita diya aur phir apni aayaat ko mustahkam bana diya, ke woh bahut zyaada jaanne waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai
Taake woh Shaitaani ilqa ko un logon ke liye aazmaaish bana de jin ke quloob mein maraz hai aur jin ke dil sakht ho gaye hain, aur zaalimeen yaqeenan bahut door-ras naafarmaani mein pade hue hain

Aur is liye bhi ke saahibaan-e-ilm ko maaloom ho jaaye ke yeh wahi Parwardigar ki taraf se barhaq hai, aur is tarah woh imaan le aayein, aur phir un ke dil us ki baargaah mein aajizi ka izhaar karein, aur yaqeenan Allah imaan laane waalon ko seedhe raaste ki taraf hidaayat karne waala hai
Aur yeh kufr ikhtiyaar karne waale hamesha us ki taraf se shubhe hi mein rahenge, yahaan tak ke achaanak un ke paas qiyaamat aa jaaye ya kisi manhoos din ka azaab waarid ho jaaye
Aaj ke din mulk Allah ke liye hai aur wahi un sab ke darmiyaan faisla karega. Phir jo log imaan le aaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye woh ne'maton waali Jannat mein rahenge
Aur jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya aur hamaari aayaton ki takzeeb ki un ke liye nihaayat darje ka ruswa-kun azaab hai
Aur jin logon ne raah-e-Khuda mein hijrat ki aur phir qatl ho gaye ya inhein maut aa gayi to yaqeenan Khuda inhein behtareen rizq ata karega, ke woh beshak behtareen rizq dene waala hai
Woh inhein aisi jagah pahunchaaega jise woh pasand karte honge, aur Allah bahut zyaada jaanne waala aur bardaasht karne waala hai

Yeh sab apne maqaam par hai, lekin us ke baad jo dushman ko utni hi saza de jitna ke use sataaya gaya hai, aur phir bhi us par zulm kiya jaaye to Khuda us ki madad zaroor karega, ke woh yaqeenan bahut maaf karne waala aur bakhshne waala hai
Yeh sab is liye hai ke Khuda raat ko din mein daakhil karta hai aur din ko raat mein daakhil karta hai, aur Allah bahut zyaada sunne waala aur dekhne waala hai
Yeh is liye hai ke Khuda hi yaqeenan barhaq hai, aur us ke ilaawa jis ko bhi yeh log pukaarte hain woh sab baatil hain, aur Allah bahut zyaada bulandi waala aur buzurgi aur azmat waala hai
Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke Allah ne aasmaan se paani barsaaya to us se zameen sar-sabz o shaadaab ho jaati hai? Yaqeenan Allah bahut zyaada meharbaan aur haalaat ki khabar rakhne waala hai
Aasmaanon aur zameen mein jo kuch bhi hai sab usi ke liye hai, aur yaqeenan woh sab se be-niyaaz aur qaabil-e-hamd o sataaish hai

Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke Allah ne tumhaare liye zameen ki tamaam cheezon ko musakhkhar kar diya hai, aur kashtiyaan bhi darya mein usi ke hukm se chalti hain, aur wahi aasmaanon ko roke hue hai ke us ki ijaazat ke baghair zameen par nahin gir sakta hai. Allah apne bandon par bada shafeeq aur meharbaan hai
Wahi Khuda hai jis ne tum ko hayaat di hai aur phir maut dega aur phir zinda karega, magar insaan bada inkaar karne waala aur naashukra hai

Har ummat ke liye ek tareeqa-e-ibaadat hai jis par woh amal kar rahi hai, lihaaza is amr mein un logon ko aap se jhagda nahin karna chaahiye, aur aap inhein apne Parwardigar ki taraf daawat dein, ke aap bilkul seedhi hidaayat ke raaste par hain
Aur agar yeh aap se jhagda karein to keh dijiye ke Allah tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai
Allah hi tumhaare darmiyaan roz-e-qiyaamat un baaton ka faisla karega jin baaton mein tum ikhtilaaf kar rahe ho
Kya tumhein nahin maaloom hai ke Allah zameen aur aasmaan ki tamaam baaton ko khoob jaanta hai, aur yeh sab baatein kitaab mein mahfooz hain, aur sab baatein Khuda ke liye bahut aasaan hain
Aur yeh log Khuda ko chhod kar un ki parastish karte hain jin ke baare mein na Khuda ne koi daleel naazil ki hai aur na khud inhein koi ilm hai, aur zaalimeen ke liye waaqai koi madadgaar nahin hai

Aur jab un ke saamne hamaari waazeh aayatein padh kar sunaayi jaati hain to tum dekhte ho ke kufr ikhtiyaar karne waalon ke chehre par naagawaari ke aasaar zaahir ho jaate hain, aur qareeb hota hai ke woh un tilaawat karne waalon par hamla kar baithein. To keh dijiye ke main is se badtar baat ke baare mein batla raha hoon, aur woh Jahannam hai jis ka Khuda ne kaafiron se waada kiya hai, aur woh bahut bura anjaam hai

Insaano! Tumhaare liye ek misl bayaan ki gayi hai, lihaaza use ghaur se suno. Yeh log jinhein tum Khuda ko chhod kar aawaaz dete ho yeh sab mil bhi jaayein to ek makkhi nahin paida kar sakte hain, aur agar makkhi un se koi cheez chheen le to yeh us se chhuda bhi nahin sakte hain, ke taalib aur matloob dono hi kamzor hain
Afsos ke un logon ne Khuda ki waaqai qadr nahin pehchaani, aur beshak Allah bada qudrat waala aur sab par ghaalib hai
Allah malaaika aur insaanon mein se apne numaainde muntakhab karta hai, aur woh bada sunne waala aur khoob dekhne waala hai
Woh un ke saamne aur pas-e-pusht ki tamaam baaton ko jaanta hai, aur tamaam umoor usi ki taraf palat kar jaane waale hain
Imaan waalo! Rukoo' karo, sajda karo aur apne Rab ki ibaadat karo aur kaar-e-khair anjaam do ke shaayad isi tarah kaamyaab ho jaao aur najaat haasil kar lo

Aur Allah ke baare mein is tarah jihaad karo jo jihaad karne ka haq hai, ke us ne tumhein muntakhab kiya hai aur deen mein koi zahmat nahin qaraar di hai. Yahi tumhaare baaba Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ka deen hai. Us ne tumhaara naam pehle bhi aur is Quran mein bhi Muslim aur itaa'at-guzaar rakha hai, taake Rasool tumhaare oopar gawaah rahe aur tum logon ke aamaal ke gawaah raho. Lihaaza ab tum namaaz qaaim karo, zakaat ada karo aur Allah se baa-qaa'ida taur par waabasta ho jaao ke wahi tumhaara Maula hai, aur wahi behtareen Maula aur behtareen madadgaar hai
